newsitem.title: USA: Spanish Broadcasting to sell 3 stations for $45mln.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Broadcasting to sell 3 stations for $45mln.

text.p: Spanish Broadcasting System Inc said Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to sell certain assets, including the FCC licenses, of radio stations WXLX-AM, New York, KXMG-AM, Los Angeles, and WCMQ-AM, Miami to One-on-One Sports Inc for $45 million.
The company said the sales were part of its plan to focus on its existing FM stations in those cities.
The company also said that acquisitions of two FM stations in Miami and one FM station in Chicago were pending.
In connection with the acquisition, One-on-One has agreed not to compete with Spanish Broadcasting System in its existing Spanish language formats.
